name: Domingo Olivera y Valadyo — parents named on a 1925 Vega Baja birth registration
researcher_question: Who were the parents of Domingo Olivera y Valadyo (b. 1867), and is the Domingo Olivera named as a father on the 1925 Vega Baja birth registration of Carmen Ester Olivera Martínez this man or his son?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 24, hint-samples.csv row 738, flags adds_father/adds_mother, confidence 3). Resolved (issue #2317): answerable differently. The 1925 hint record names the subject as the child's paternal grandfather, a generation shift; the father is his son Domingo Olivera y González (GN52-SH9). The subject's parents, Juan José Olivera Rolón and Concepción Albaladejo, come from his son Juan Félix's 1902 Ciales birth registration and his own 1926 Vega Baja death registration.
